name: Akai Homura
source: A tomboy who loves lazing around, and who's a big fan of hot-blooded super hero and mecha anime series. She's made into the school's student council president by the principal in an effort to change her behavior. She's best friends with Akane Ichimonji and Headmaster Bakuretsuzan; Mei Ijuin is her arch-enemy.
